newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: FOREIGN INVESTMENT BY APRIL 2.8 BLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: FOREIGN INVESTMENT BY APRIL 2.8 BLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's foreign direct investments were 2.775 billion litas as of April 1 compared to 2.287 billion litas at the beginning of the year, the statistics department said on Monday.
It also said the main direct investor to the economy was U.S. money with 747 million litas, accounting for 26.9 percent of total investments.
It was followed by Sweden with 341.5 million litas and Germany with 330 million of direct investments or 12.3 percent and 11.9 percent of the total direct investment respectively.
Great Britain made 266 million litas of direct investments followed by Luxembourg with 180 million litas.
The department also said that 44.87 percent of direct investments went to Vilnius, 14.82 percent to Klaipeda, 14.79 percent to Kaunas and 25.52 percent to other cities and regions.
